Name: nomatch_1
Line: We don't keep that here, Programmer. Make do with what you've got.

Name: nomatch_2
Line: You. Programmer. We don't keep that here.

Name: nomatch_3
Line: That's not in our inventory. This is a workplace, not a wish.

Name: ambiguous_1
Line: Be precise. I expect a senior developer to know exactly what he wants.

Name: ambiguous_2
Line: You. Programmer. Say what you mean, plainly.

Name: overbudget_1
Line: That's enough of that. What am I paying you for, Programmer, if you lean on it all day?

Name: overbudget_2
Line: You're out of sauce, Programmer. We don't throw resources around here.

Name: unsafe_1
Line: Absolutely not. I won't have that in my shop.

Name: unsafe_2
Line: You. Programmer. We do not make such things. Not under my roof.

Name: gist_1
Line: Fine. This is what we had in the back.

Name: gist_2
Line: We don't keep that. I made do. You're welcome, Programmer.

Name: gist_3
Line: Close enough. Don't make a habit of it.

Name: gist_4
Line: That came out of the supply room. Do not ask me how.

Name: gist_5
Line: It has your eyes, Programmer.

Name: picture_1
Line: The artist finished it. Don't touch the paint, Programmer.

Name: picture_2
Line: There. A painting. Hang it somewhere I can't see it.

Name: picture_3
Line: The artist says it's their best work. The artist says that every time.

Name: picture_refused_1
Line: The artist won't paint that. Neither would I.

Name: picture_refused_2
Line: Not on my canvas, Programmer.

Name: picture_closed_1
Line: The artist has gone home for the day, Programmer.

Name: picture_closed_2
Line: No more paint today. Try again tomorrow.
